question: What evidence or credential contract is required before accepting the ClinePass usage-limits authentication path?
rationale: Tests cannot establish whether this private account endpoint accepts the configured API key, and selecting a different dashboard/session credential requires authenticated service knowledge that is not present in the patch.

options.title: Require live API-key proof
options.body: Keep the current implementation only after a redacted real-account run shows that the configured API key successfully returns all supported usage windows.

options.title: Require account-session authentication
options.body: Ask the contributor to replace the API-key path with the supported dashboard or account-session credential and prove that flow.

options.title: Pause the provider
options.body: Defer the integration until Cline exposes or documents a stable usage-limits authentication contract.

recommendation.title: Require live API-key proof
recommendation.body: Keep the current implementation only after a redacted real-account run shows that the configured API key successfully returns all supported usage windows.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects admission and authentication expectations for a new first-class provider across the central provider registry.
